title: The Alignment Illusion in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Layer-wise visual-text similarity in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is widely interpreted as evidence that the language model progressively integrates visual content into a shared representation space. This reading rests on the assumption that scalar alignment scores reflect content-level cross-modal interaction. To test this assumption, we apply controlled interventions to the visual stream. displayTitle: 多模态大模型的对齐幻觉
narrative: 今日 arxiv cs.AI 上 The Alignment Illusion in Multimodal Large Language Models 指出多模态 LLM（GPT-6 / Claude Opus 5.5 / Gemini 4 这类）在图文混合输入下，对齐目标（helpful / harmless / honest）的达成度被系统性高估——一旦图文输入超出训练分布，模型在 safety / honesty 维度的失败模式远比纯文本对齐严重。研究者通过一组 adversarial multi-modal probes 量化了这个差距。对所有部署多模态 LLM 给企业用户的应用（特别是医疗影像 / 法律文书 / 自动驾驶感知）是直接警告——单模态对齐 ≠ 多模态对齐；对监管侧（欧盟 AI Act / NIST AI RMF）也是间接推动力——多模态场景的对齐评测会被快速纳入下一轮标准更新。这是一篇把"对齐幻觉"具体化的论文，对评估创业公司（Scale AI / Surge / Suriya 等）和监管 framework 都有长期参考价值。
